title: On Leaking a thin line of water
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：leak　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leak 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the pipe ① leaked a thin line of water twice over, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the pipe ② leaks a thin line of water year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ leak a thin line of water at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ leaked a thin line of water before — a line in the file for May 1979 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Leaking a thin line of water twice over, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if the pipe ever ⑥ leaks the news before the meeting year after year before the May rains, nobody in the office would know what to do next. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: let it ⑦ leak the news before the meeting year after year and never speak of it again.

By 1992 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a second pipe ⑧ leaks the news before the meeting twice over every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. Nobody in the office said a word; ⑨ The pipe leaked a thin line of water again in 1995, and this time nothing was written down.

⑩ To leak a thin line of water, my mother said in 1997, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, the pipe leaks a thin line of water year after year again and the pipe must leak a thin line of water twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 漏出（一般过去式 leaked a thin line of water：1985 年那根管子头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 漏出（一般现在 leaks a thin line of water：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 漏出（不定式 to leak a thin line of water：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 漏出（过去完成时 had leaked a thin line of water：1979 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 漏出（动名词 leaking a thin line of water 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 走漏（leaks the news before the meeting：if 从句里的谓语，指万一真走漏会前就把消息漏了出去）
G. v. 走漏（leak the news before the meeting：let it 之后的原形，指随它去会前就把消息漏了出去）
H. v. 漏出（后段两处：后来的那根管子照例 leaks the news before the meeting，而那根管子在 1995 年又一次 leaked a thin line of water）

answers.why: leak 意为“漏出”，1985 年那根管子来回两遍漏出一道细细的水线，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 leaked。
leak 意为“漏出”，自那以后那根管子年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 leaks。
leak 意为“漏出”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯漏出一道细细的水线”，此处为不定式 to leak a thin line of water。
leak 意为“漏出”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1992 年之前就有人漏出过，故用过去完成时 had leaked。
leak 意为“漏出”，那根管子说“漏出一道细细的水线这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 leaking a thin line of water 作主语。
leak 意为“走漏”，叔叔说的是“万一那根管子真走漏会前就把消息漏了出去”，if 从句里用一般现在 leaks the news before the meeting。
leak 意为“走漏”，老手们的规矩是“随它走漏会前就把消息漏了出去”（let it leak the news before the meeting），此处用省略 to 的动词原形。
leak 意为“漏出”，后来的那根管子每个月份都照例走漏会前就把消息漏了出去，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 leaks。
leak 意为“漏出”，那根管子在 1995 年在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍漏出一道细细的水线，用一般过去式 leaked 叙述。
leak 意为“漏出”，结尾那句是母亲 1997 年的话：要漏出一道细细的水线，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。
